name: Please Be Quiet Pickering 2022

venue.name: [Chestnut Hill Developments Recreation Complex](https://www.pickering.ca/en/recreation.aspx)
venue.address: 1867 Valley Farm Rd, Pickering, ON L1V 6K7

information:
### Please be quiet!

The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to "please be quiet" at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [Ajax First-Timers 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AjaxFirstTimers2022) if this competition isn't for you.
